description: This file defines a question generator agent using a state machine workflow with validation, capable of generating single or multiple questions concurrently for a medical exam prep application.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: TypedDict schema representing the state of the question generation workflow

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflow, including validation and batch processing

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the question generator agent and builds the workflow graph

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the state machine workflow for question generation

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Decides whether to regenerate a question based on validation results and attempt count

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a single validated question for a given chapter and difficulty

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronously generates multiple questions in batches with concurrency control
